function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Authenticate the customer before any debt information can be disclosed. This is the ONLY tool that can establish verified authentication status. Must be called before get_account_details, log_promise_to_pay, or send_payment_link.

verification_method.description: Method of verification: date of birth (DDMMYYYY), 4-digit OTP, last 4 digits of registered phone, or last 4 digits of loan account

verification_value.description: The verification value provided by the customer

function.name: get_account_details
function.description: Retrieve full account and debt details. REQUIRES successful authentication (verify_customer must have returned verified=true). Will return 403 if called on unverified session.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Record a Promise-to-Pay commitment from the customer. REQUIRES successful authentication. Validates date is within 30 days and amount is positive and not exceeding total outstanding.

ptp_date.description: Promised payment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be today or future, max 30 days out.

ptp_amount.description: Promised payment amount in INR. Must be > 0 and <= total outstanding.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Send a payment link via SMS or WhatsApp (mocked). REQUIRES successful authentication. Defaults to total outstanding amount if amount not specified.

amount.description: Optional: amount for payment link. Defaults to total outstanding.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Transfer the call to a human agent with full context. Can be called from ANY state (does not require authentication). Use for disputes, hardship, hostile behavior, auth failures, or customer request.

summary.description: Brief summary of conversation context for the human agent

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Log the final call disposition/outcome for reporting. Terminal action - call ends after this. Does not require authentication.

ptp_id.description: Required if disposition is promise_to_pay. The PTP record ID from log_promise_to_pay.

escalation_id.description: Required if disposition is escalated. The escalation record ID from escalate_to_agent.
